about: TaleSpark 2.2: the words that name an object on the map -> its sprite. move = drawn from straight above (sprites/top/<name>.png, turned to its heading), still = 3/4 aerial view (sprites/<set>/<name>.png or sprites/objects/<name>.png). Arabic words are written without tashkeel and without the article (the checkers strip و ف ب ل and ال). desc = what the ChatGPT sheet draws. A word found in a script whose sprite file does not exist yet asks for a sheet (script_check.mjs, the app's Kit.kt).
